visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women stand in front of a dark gray wall decorated with large red calligraphy that reads "start from". The woman on the left wears a white crop top, a blue and white striped beanie, and loose pinstriped trousers. The woman on the right wears a white tank top, a blue baseball cap, and ripped jeans with a blue plaid shirt tied around her waist. They pose with stylized hand gestures, smiling directly at the camera in a bright indoor setting. (2) The camera zooms out as the two women begin a synchronized dance routine. They perform energetic hip-hop movements, including fluid arm waves, sharp chest pops, and coordinated footwork. Their facial expressions are joyful and expressive as they move in unison. The lighting is consistent and bright, highlighting their casual streetwear and the texture of the background wall. (3) They continue the choreography, incorporating more dynamic body rolls and rhythmic hand movements. The camera work is handheld, following the dancers with slight shifts and zooms to maintain focus on their performance. They point towards each other and the camera, maintaining a high level of engagement and energy throughout the sequence. (4) The routine reaches its peak with faster, more intricate movements before the women transition into a final series of playful poses. One woman kicks her leg up towards the wall while the other laughs and moves slightly out of the main frame. They both appear relaxed and happy, concluding the performance by moving towards the background as the scene ends.
